subject: Auditing and Ethics
question_text:
4.
Mr. B, an Articled Clerk responsible for the audit procedures concerning
inventory, found that the inventory amounting to ` 38 lakhs, after excluding
` 2 lakhs of inventory that was held by PQ Ltd. as a consignee, has been
recognized in the Balance Sheet. Which of the following assertions related to
inventory are applicable in this situation?
(I)  Occurrence
(II)  Completeness
(III)  Rights & Obligations
(IV)  Measurement
(A)  I & II above
(B)  II & III above
(C)  III & IV above
(D)  I & IV above
(2 Marks)
